about: Agent Teams: spawn_teammate takes llm_provider, model and reasoning_effort for a fresh teammate (checked against DSH's subagent model selection), list_teammate_models, and each teammate's own route in the roster. Delete it in the release whose dsh has the change upstream.

Frontend static server: index.html gets cache-control: no-cache and a weak ETag from the rendered bytes, and a matching If-None-Match gets an empty 304, so a normal reload after a plugin update cannot keep a stale manifest or client bundle. No Last-Modified: a plugin update can rewrite the manifest without touching index.html's mtime, so a content ETag is the only correct validator (the desktop runtime and the server image both apply this patch). Delete it in the DSH release that serves the index with cache directives.

Connection: the browser-session cookie is SameSite=Lax instead of Strict. A launch link opened from a phone camera or QR is a top-level cross-site navigation, and the redirected ./ request withholds a Strict cookie, so authorizeIndex answers the 401 failed-authentication page; Lax sends the cookie on that navigation (#632). HttpOnly, the computed Secure attribute and the 303 are unchanged. Delete it in the DSH release whose browser-session cookie is Lax.

Client layout: the sidebar and right panel widths are saved in localStorage under dsh.layout.widths and restored when the client plugin reloads, instead of resetting on every reload (#483). setSidebar, setRightbar and openRightbar save the width the user chose; a right panel width chosen on a wider frame is kept as the preference when the viewport shrinks (the renderer clamps only the display), a hand-stored sidebar 0 restores as the default 280, and toggleSidebar reopens at the last positive sidebar width. Missing, unreadable or invalid stored values fall back to the contract defaults. Delete it in the DSH release whose ui-layout persists the panel widths itself.
